To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the integration of opportunistic control with instructional planning is an effective method of designing intelligent tutoring systems.

the instructional planner can be implemented by integrating opportunistic control with instructional planning methods, that the instructional planner is capable of dynamically planning, and that the instructional planner supports mixed-initiative interaction.

1) a combination of opportunistic and instructional planning is a feasible approach to building intelligent tutors; 2) the instructional planning approach can be applied successfully to the development of an intelligent tutoring system; 3) a two level discourse management system is a feasible approach for discourse planning; and 4) a mixed-initiative strategy is a viable approach to building intelligent tutoring systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of developing a tutoring system that is intelligent in its instructional planning and discourse management.
the design and development issues for an instructional planner that integrates opportunism and sophisticated lesson planning.
the design and development an instructional planner for Cardiovascular Physiology tutoring system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this thesis describes a system which is capable of generating lesson plans dynamically based on student model and which can also carry out the student's initiative during the tutoring session, and can do replanning after the student's request, and which is based on the explicit representation of pedagogical knowledge.

the instructional planner for Cardiovascular Physiology is a working prototype of a mixed initiative intelligent tutoring system that combines the capabilities of opportunistic control with lesson planning and discourse planning.
the planner is a successful attempt in integrating opportunistic control with global lesson planning and discourse management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system is able to plan dynamically, and the system can be used as a tutoring system for first year medical students.
we have successfully designed and developed a tutoring system with a dynamic instructional planner that combines the advantages of both global and local planning.
we have designed and developed a system for Cardiovascular Tutor, which is an intelligent tutoring system that combines global lesson planning with local discourse planning.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to build an effective tutoring system that is capable of generating and carrying out a variety of instructional strategies, and that is capable of dynamically adapting to the student's behavior.
it is possible to build an intelligent tutoring system with sophisticated instructional planning capabilities that is able to support a mixed-initiative strategy.
it is possible to combine global lesson plans with opportunistic control in an ITS.
